title: UPD  Script Project AuroraHud
features:
a clean arsenal script with the basics

[Combat]

Aimbot: Smoothness and FOV settings.

Triggerbot: Auto-fires when crosshair is on enemies.

Hitbox: Precise size and transparency controls.

AutoFarm: High-risk automation for XP/Money.

[Visuals]

ESP: Boxes, Names, and Tracers (Perspective Corrected).

Full Bright: Removes all map shadows and fog.

FOV Changer: Direct control over Arsenal's internal FOV.

[Weaponry]

Infinite Ammo: Never reload or run out.

No Spread: Perfect crosshair accuracy.

No Recoil: Zero camera kickback.

[Movement]

Fly: Standard flight with speed control.

Custom Speed: Velocity-based walkspeed.

Infinite Jump: Jump as many times as you want in mid-air.

[Utility]

Server Hop: Travel to a new Arsenal server.

Rejoin: Quickly rejoin your current session.

TimeScale: Locally speed up or slow down time.
